scope: Supplemental CPU metadata and file-byte audit of all18 completed fresh A60 refits; no V rescoring or gradient/training replay
limitations: This checks saved metadata, exposed arithmetic and file bindings, not a rerun of training, differentiation, gradients, optimizer numerics or frozen F inference
weights_only=True with explicit known NumPy container/dtype allowlist was used; saved model tensor contents and normalization values were not inspected or arithmetically evaluated
model_state_sha agreement is metadata equality only; model tensor hashes were not independently recomputed
No V prediction archive was opened and no V row/score was inspected or rescored; REFIT_RESULT JSON was parsed only for permitted top-level contracts, bindings and fit/refit/search metadata
Prepared prefix files were byte-hashed only; source arrays were not decoded and scaler population statistics were not recomputed in this supplemental audit
The single ceil(E/16) formula is valid here for the fresh single selected refit segment; search updates consist of segment-wise ceilings and were deliberately not subjected to this formula
This certifies all18 refit metadata records, not Direct MLP/cost-stage completion, overall experiment success, convergence, statistical significance or independent TEST performance
